closureWork: Implemented selectable storage backends for JSON, SQLite via better-sqlite3, Postgres/Neon via pg, and Cloudflare D1 via REST query API.
Added storage verification route that writes audit state through the active adapter.
Registered provider-pack routes as first-class executable actions inside the action registry.
Removed obsolete legacy step methods from PlatformEngine so workflow execution is registry-driven only.
Added webhook dispatch rules and replay-to-workflow dispatch behavior.
Added queue lock extension and dead-letter retry paths.
Expanded OpenAPI and request validation coverage for new routes.
Fixed visual graph runner duplicate step recording.
knownOpenItems: SQLite/Postgres/D1 adapters require their live env and optional dependency/API access before live backend proof can be claimed.
Browser Chromium proof remains environment-dependent if local policy blocks localhost/headless access.
